Poly Haven assets licence

All assets on Poly Haven are licensed as CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication):
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The licence and the public API terms are those recorded earlier the same day in
polyhaven-materials-license-2026-11-12.txt, unchanged from the copy saved on 2026-10-23
(polyhaven-materials-license-2026-10-23.txt). The licence covers every Poly Haven asset, models as well as
textures.

Textures added to the material library lock on 2026-11-12 (diffuse, normal and roughness maps, 1k and 2k jpg,
via https://api.polyhaven.com/files/<id>, pinned by md5 in tools/blender/materials/polyhaven.lock.json),
for the ground, rock and timber of the 3D wild scenes (Gallows Wood, The Fenwood, the Tin Gallery):
- forrest_ground_03: Forest Ground 03 (Rob Tuytel)
- quarry_wall_02: Quarry Wall 02 (Dimitrios Savva)
- raw_wooden_floor_01: Raw Wooden Floor 01 (Charlotte Baglioni)
- rocks_ground_08: Rocks Ground 08 (Rob Tuytel)
- seaside_rock: Seaside Rock (Dimitrios Savva)
- snow_03: Snow 03 (Rob Tuytel)

Models taken on 2026-11-12, the first Poly Haven models in the repository (each the 1k glTF, or the 1k .blend
where the glTF drops an alpha or opacity map, with every .bin and texture file it includes, via
https://api.polyhaven.com/files/<id>, pinned by md5 in tools/blender/materials/polyhaven_models.lock.json and
fetched by tools/blender/materials/fetch_models.py), for the rocks, plants and props of the same scenes:
- dry_branches_medium_01: Dry Branches Medium 01 (Rico Cilliers), 1k glTF
- fern_02: Fern 02 (Rico Cilliers, Rob Tuytel), 1k .blend
- grass_medium_02: Grass Medium 02 (Rico Cilliers), 1k .blend
- picke_dirty_01: Picke Dirty 01 (Dennis Halbeck), 1k glTF
- rock_07: Rock 07 (Jenelle van Heerden), 1k glTF
- rock_face_01: Rock Face 01 (Dario Barresi), 1k glTF
- rock_face_02: Rock Face 02 (Dario Barresi, Rico Cilliers), 1k glTF
- rock_moss_set_01: Rock Moss Set 01 (Kless Gyzen), 1k glTF
- rock_moss_set_02: Rock Moss Set 02 (Kless Gyzen), 1k glTF
- rusted_spade_01: Rusted Spade 01 (Blemonade), 1k glTF
- shrub_02: Shrub 02 (Rico Cilliers), 1k .blend
- single_root: Single Root (Jenelle van Heerden), 1k glTF
- tree_stump_01: Tree Stump 01 (Rob Tuytel), 1k glTF
- wooden_lantern_01: Wooden Lantern 01 (James Ray Cock), 1k .blend
